_comment: Settings for the work queue. Installed as queue.config.json in the project root. Missing fields get the defaults in scripts/orchestrator/lib/queueConfig.js. Keys starting with _ are comments.
_mode: "mode": "lite" = the core loop only (add with just a title, no classes, value or batch queue to learn); "full" = every feature. Without the key the mode is full, but a fresh `cq init` writes lite (`cq init --full` to opt out). Switch any time with `cq mode lite|full`.
_gates: Shell commands the tracks run before delivery (gates.mjs --quick / --full). Empty lists = no gates. precheck (gates.mjs --precheck) runs first and stops at the first red check; null = the standard checks, or a list where {changed} = the changed files and {file} = once per file.
_doneCheck: The done command (task field done_when): receive and merge run it in the track's worktree; exit != 0 gives a fix round instead of review or merge. timeoutSec = time budget per run; tailLines = the last output lines kept for the fix brief (only the tail is kept). maxFixRounds = fix rounds per task before it becomes an owner question (task field max_fix_rounds overrides).
_baseGate: The base gate: after cq merge the base branch's new tip is checked in the main checkout and the verdict recorded per tip (scripts/.queue/base-health.json). While it is red, cq merge refuses other tracks (exit 9; --force-red-base overrides, logged) and a fix task <id>-BASE<n> is added. enabled: auto (on when there are commands), true or false. commands: null = the quick gates (the merge step's own gates run is the check), or a list run after them. timeoutSec = budget for the whole list; tailLines null = doneCheck.tailLines.
_push: The batch push threshold, counted in merged tasks (cq merge) not yet on <remote>/<baseBranch>. mode: owner (push only on the owner's word) or threshold (the orchestrator may push when cq push-check says READY or LARGE, never BLOCKED). minTasks: READY from this many (0 = no lower limit); below it, or on a red base, the push guard asks before a plain push of the base branch (never denies). warnTasks: LARGE from this many (push recommended; 0 = off). maxAgeHours: null, or unpushed work older than this makes the batch READY below minTasks.
_productionBranch: The branch that goes live (null = unknown). cq doctor warns when it equals baseBranch: every batch push would then go to production.
_deployCommands: Commands that deploy; the push guard asks before any command that starts with one of them (agents and the main session). Empty = off. Examples: ["vercel --prod", "fly deploy", "firebase deploy", "npm run deploy"].
_secretScan: Before a plain push of baseBranch from the main session, the added lines of what is pushed are scanned for secrets (gitleaks when on PATH, else a few built-in patterns); a hit asks with file:line, never the value. A diff over maxBytes is skipped silently; timeoutMs per git or gitleaks call. Fails open.
_largeFileMb: cq doctor warns about tracked files larger than this (MB).
_migrations: Optional numbered migrations. folder = null turns the whole migration flow off.
architectureRules: Example rule: the UI layer never calls the database directly.
_modules: Areas of the product for the plan register (queue.mjs plan modules).

modules.title: Example
modules.description: Example module, rename or delete it

modules.title: No area yet
modules.description: Projects that do not belong to an area yet

_models: Model per agent (track, track-d, reviewer, reviewer-docs, a helper ...): opus, sonnet, haiku or fable. Empty = each agent file's own model (opus). A set model is printed on the start lines as model=<m> and passed to the Agent tool. Measure the effect with cq cost before and after.
_prices: The list prices for the cost measurement (USD per MTok). null = the built-in table per model family (scripts/orchestrator/lib/timeCost.js PRICE_TABLE: Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, Fable). Override per model id or a part of it, e.g. { "opus-4-1": { "input": 15, "output": 75, "cache_read": 1.5 } }; cache_5m and cache_1h default to 1.25x and 2x the input price.
_metrics: Transcript metrics in the time log: idleGapMin = a gap longer than this many minutes between two transcript entries is idle and not counted in active_s (the active time).
_triage: Intake triage: before fill starts a task added or last edited minAgeDays ago or more (null = no age rule), or one an agent added (agentAdded, once), the triage helper checks it read-only against the current code: ready, done, stale or adjust (cq triage <id> --verdict ...). Never fix tasks or continuations. Off: cq helpers off triage. Lite mode: off unless switched on.
_focus: When a focus has ended (every stage done, or its period is over): continueWhenEmpty false (default) pauses the queue (fill starts nothing) and asks the owner one question in Waiting on you: set a new focus or continue the regular queue. true = the queue continues by itself, with one line saying so. Per focus: cq focus set ... --continue-when-empty on|off. A project that never set a focus is not affected.
_protectedPaths: Merge guard: paths a track may only change when its task owns them (owned_files/shared_patch); otherwise merge-track stops with exit 4 (--allow-guard overrides). "folder/", "dir/file", a bare file name (any folder) or a glob with * or ? (without a slash: the file name in any folder). The default list in queueConfig.js also holds the test, lint and type configs (vitest.config.*, tsconfig*.json, pytest.ini, pyproject.toml, Cargo.toml, Makefile ...). Leave the field out for the default list; a list here REPLACES it (copy the entries you keep); [] turns the guard off.
_testWeakening: receive warns (never stops) about deleted test files, test files moved out of the test paths and added skip/focus markers in test files (.skip(, .only(, xit(, @pytest.mark.skip, #[ignore], t.Skip(, @Disabled ...): one WARN line and a Test weakening section in 00-package.md. testPaths: more test file globs; markers: more regular expressions.
_loadGuard: Load guard: next, start and fill refuse new starts (exit 7, THE MACHINE IS FULL) while free memory is below minFreeMemoryPct percent. null = off. Default 10 (off on macOS, which reports the page cache as used). cq limit minFreeMemoryPct <n|off> overrides it for the queue.
_loadGuardAdaptive: Load-aware slots: above the hard limit, fill/next/start open fewer than maxConcurrent slots while free memory is below allSlotsFreeMemoryPct (default 40, off on macOS), at least minSlots (1), linear in between; the commands print why (LOAD: 2 of 5 slots: ...). CPU is optional: set both allSlotsCpuPct and minSlotsCpuPct (e.g. 60 and 95). adaptive false or QUEUE_LOAD_ADAPTIVE=off turns it off; fill --over-load skips it.
_proposals: Auto-accept of agent proposals (default off): a proposal that fits the rules is approved by the queue itself, logged and can be undone (cq proposals). Never D or D+, never with waiting_on, legal/owner labels, open legal points or protected paths. cq proposals auto and the board write the queue's own rules, which win.
_qa: QA evidence: tracks write EVIDENCE <type>[=<ref>] in report.md and receive stores it. autoTypes are closed by cq qa auto --run when autoCommand is green ({refs} = the refs, {id} = the task id; a string or { type: command }). evidenceLabels = labels receive warns for when the line is missing.
_capacity: Weekly quota reset used by queue.mjs capacity. null = default (Tuesday 19:00 local time). resetDay 0-6, 0 = Sunday.
_board: mascot: the speech bubble on the board, "chatty", "events" (only events and clicks) or "off" (no bubbles for anyone). queue-board.mjs --mascot overrides it. updateCheck: the board looks for a newer plugin version on GitHub at most once per 24 hours (a plain GET, nothing about you is sent); false turns it off. showCloud: show the Cloud tab (only with features.cloud on); `cq board-setting cloud on|off` sets it in queue.json, which wins.
_features: Modules that can be switched off or on. cloud and follow also answer "off" in the CLI; plans.* only hide parts of the board (the CLI plan register always works). Unknown keys are ignored.
